key_insight: A scenario-free robust bilevel DLMP framework can coordinate EV active/reactive charging and distribution dispatch under uncertain load and PV generation while preserving price signals.
engineering_relevance: This enables distribution operators and EV aggregators to improve voltage security, lower charging cost, and provide reactive support without the heavy computation of scenario-based optimization.
method: Upper level: EV aggregator jointly schedules active and reactive charging power to minimize charging cost.
Lower level: energy management solves network-constrained economic dispatch and computes DLMPs with feeder and voltage limits.
Compact robust counterpart reformulates net-demand uncertainty using a normal-minus-beta model, then KKT/Big-M linearization preserves economic interpretation of DLMPs.
evidence_signal: Validated on the IEEE 33-bus distribution system, where the method improved voltage security and reduced computational complexity versus conventional stochastic and robust approaches.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurate uncertainty modeling and careful Big-M/KKT reformulation to avoid overly conservative schedules or numerical issues.
paper_title: Scenario-Free Uncertainty-Aware DLMP-Based Bilevel Coordination of EV Charging and Reactive Power Support in Distribution Networks
